description: Parses flipcode and submits a cloud MP4 render under the API key owner's FlipLetters plan (same free quota / Premium / Studio limits as the Studio). Requires FLIPLETTERS_API_KEY. Polls until done (or returns jobId if wait=false). Prefer share links for free previews; only render when the human wants an MP4 file.

repeat.description: Loop the segment this many times (default 1). Caps apply for long / 4K exports.

wait.description: If true (default), poll until done/error. If false, return jobId immediately.

name: flipletters_render_board
title: Cloud-render a board to MP4
